title: feat(roadmap): refuse a what_changes item that names no group path
summary: The plan of the change of #3411 names `src/devops_cli/lang/en/messages.py` in a What Changes item, and its one group lists the file in neither `changes` nor `creates`. The Impact section that the stage job renders from the groups leaves the message file out, so a reader cannot see that it changes and the implement step has no group that edits it.
notes: The plan is the one of this change before the check of #3411 exists: the group adds the check to `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage_change.py` and no group lists the message file that its second What Changes item names.
The change was never merged as this plan, so `pull`, `merge_commit` and `base_commit` hold the issue number and two placeholders: the case reads no commit, and the facts hold the files of its tree.
